is_urgent.instructions: Does this message convey urgency or time-sensitivity?

criteria.true: Explicitly time-sensitive, or describes an ongoing loss

criteria.technical: Bugs, outages, integrations that do not work
criteria.feedback: Praise, suggestions, anything needing no action

frustration.instructions: How frustrated does the customer appear?

bug_severity.instructions: If this reports a defect, how severe is it?
criteria: Data loss, or a total outage

refund_requested.instructions: Is the customer asking for money back?

criteria.true: Asks for a refund, reversal or credit
